startersHint: A starter sets what is printed: report cards, a rank list, grades only, or pass and fail. The preview shows a sample class until you add your own marks.
marksHint: Copy the marks from your spreadsheet and paste them here. The first row names the columns: Name, then optionally Roll, then one column for each subject. Write a subject like Maths (50) to set its maximum marks. Leave a cell empty or write AB for an absent student.
marksPlaceholder:
Name	Roll	Maths (100)	Science (100)
Riya Sharma	1	92	88
readFailed: The marks could not be read. Paste a header row and at least one student row, with the name in the first column.
sampleShown: No marks yet, so the preview shows a sample class.
maxHint: Worked out from the headings. Change a number if it is wrong.
bandsHint: One line for each grade: the lowest percentage, the grade and an optional remark, for example 80 A Very good. These are only an example. Use your school's own.
passHint: A student who scores below this in any subject, or is absent, is shown as Fail. Use your school's own rule.
rankOn: Show the rank on each card
cardsOn: Include a report card for each student

outputs.zip: A zip with one PDF for each student

outputHint: A zip is best for sending each parent their own child's card on WhatsApp.
keepOpen: Keep this page open until it is done.
failed: The file could not be made. Try fewer students.
nothing: Choose at least a rank list or the report cards.
tooMany: The most you can make at once is {max} students. Split your list into classes.
csv: Save the results as a spreadsheet file (CSV)
notSelectable: The pages are saved as pictures so Hindi and other scripts look right. The text in the PDF cannot be selected or searched.
notSaved: Student marks are never saved or uploaded. Only the school name, exam name and options are remembered on this device.
